text: The investor eligibility line has become arbitrary in the credit space: private funds implementing substantially the same investment strategy as a fixed income unconstrained mutual fund, and carrying substantially the same risks, may be sold only to high net worth and sophisticated investors through private placements.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Unconstrained Mutual Funds and Retail Investor Protection (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2811729

isBasedOn.name: Unconstrained Mutual Funds and Retail Investor Protection

abstract: purchased by high net worth and sophisticated investors through private placements, although the private funds implement substantially the same investment strategy as a fixed income-focused UMF, and are subject to substantially the same types of strategic and other investment risks as a UMF.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: fixed income focused unconstrained mutual funds compared with credit private funds
